title: Meal Plan Pantry Duplication Waste
dataSources: Amazon order records (`amazon:order`), meal-plan inventory (`mealplan:item`), and pharmacy refill events (`pharmacy:refill`).
app: Household logistics telemetry from Amazon order history, meal-plan inventory tools, and pharmacy refill portals sent to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mealplan:item
| search duplicate_qty>0
| stats sum(duplicate_qty) as duplicate_qty sum(duplicate_cost) as duplicate_cost by ingredient_name
| sort 0 - duplicate_qty
description: Ranks ingredientss by pantry duplication waste.
value: Duplicate pantry buys are one of the clearest signs that the inventory system is not steering shopping well enough.
implementation: Send pantry duplication waste events to `index=personal` and keep `ingredient_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of pantry duplication waste by ingredients.
grandmaExplanation: It totals which ingredientss stand out most for pantry duplication waste.
